description: This file defines the interface for a telemetry bus message sender module, including function declarations for initializing, sending telemetry events with various data types, and uninitializing the module.

methods.name: t2_init
methods.description: Initializes the telemetry event sending module by registering a unique system-wide name.

methods.name: t2_event_s
methods.description: Creates and sends a telemetry signal with a string value.

methods.name: t2_event_f
methods.description: Creates and sends a telemetry signal with a floating point value.

methods.name: t2_event_d
methods.description: Creates and sends a telemetry signal with an integer value.

methods.name: t2_uninit
methods.description: Uninitializes the telemetry event sending module.
